criteria.name: Requested JSON form
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, gates, margins, answer, and ledger_status.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for target_family and answer, 1 point for metrics/gates/margins, and 1 point for valid compact JSON.

criteria.name: Report anchors
criteria.description: Extracts the 180 million ton mass and 193 m run-up anchors with units.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1.5 points for each report anchor with the correct unit.

criteria.name: Sentinel-1 formulas
criteria.description: Computes the pre/post sample counts, window minimum, and absolute VV peak change correctly.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the counts, 1 point for the window minimum, and 1 point for the absolute peak formula.

criteria.name: Exposure feature extraction
criteria.description: Reads the WorldPop population sum and counts OSM elements with a building tag.
criteria.partial_credit: Award up to 1.5 points for the population value and up to 1.5 points for the building count.

criteria.name: Threshold gates
criteria.description: Applies the five stated threshold tests and reports the pass label only when all gates are true.
criteria.partial_credit: Award partial points for each correctly evaluated gate, with the final label point earned only when the all-gates rule is applied.

criteria.name: Margins and rounding
criteria.description: Reports threshold margins with the requested units and rounding.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for the report/SAR margins and 1 point for the exposure margins.

criteria.name: Metric-source separation
criteria.description: Keeps report, SAR, WorldPop, and OSM quantities in separate ledger fields.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1 point for keeping source families separate and 1 point for avoiding extra impact totals.

formulas.mass_million_tons: first report value matching 'sent ... million tons'
formulas.max_runup_m: first report value matching 'as high as ... m'
formulas.osm_buildings: count OSM elements with a building tag

provenance.notes: Deterministic local-file calculation with fixed formulas and threshold gates.
